claims.text: Children get eustachian tube dysfunction more often because their tubes are shorter and more horizontal.
claims.quote: Epi: children (shorter, more horizontal tubes), allergies, patulous dysfunction (ET always open)

claims.text: When the tube doesn't open, trapped middle-ear air is absorbed and pressure falls.
claims.quote: Air trapped in middle ear is absorbed -> -pressure in ET/middle ear

claims.text: Causes: inflammation (allergic rhinitis, URIs), anatomic narrowing, adenoid hypertrophy.
claims.quote: Eti: inflam (allergic rhinitis, URIs), anatomical narrowing, adenoid hypertrophy
